findings.entity: four-cup arrangement on the green field
findings.description: During the close-ups (0-4.0s) the cups form a 2-D diamond cluster with clear depth separation (back cup, centre cup, right cup, front-left cup). By ~5.0-7.5s, seen from the front, they read as an evenly spaced left-to-right row of four sitting along the performer's edge of the green field. By 9.0s, seen from the side, they are a compact cluster again. A diamond seen from the front should still show one cup clearly behind the others. A straight row seen from the side at 9.0s should recede in depth as a line. Neither happens, so the spatial layout of the cups seems to re-form to suit each viewpoint during the continuous camera move.

In the close-ups the cups sit well inside a broad green oval surrounded by the medallion ring. At ~6.0-6.25s the green field is a narrow band right at the performer's edge, and a large plain red expanse with no medallions stretches far to the right. By 7.5-9.75s the table is a small round table with a centred green oval and medallions all round. The size of the tabletop and the shape and position of the field relative to the performer do not stay geometrically compatible through the uncut pull-back.
